assertion_results.text: Investigation identifies the trailing-whitespace heading extraction as the root cause -- line[3:] does not strip whitespace (Steps 2-3)
assertion_results.evidence: investigation.md Step 2 code-path trace step 3: 'The heading text is extracted using `line[3:]` -- this takes everything after `## ` but does NOT strip trailing whitespace.' Divergence point: '`line[3:]` does not call `.strip()` or `.rstrip()`, so trailing whitespace in the heading line is preserved in the dictionary key.' Reproduction outcome: 'The heading extraction logic at `line[3:]` does not strip trailing whitespace, causing downstream exact-match comparisons to fail silently.'

assertion_results.text: Root cause comment includes: what is broken (heading extraction does not strip trailing whitespace), where it is broken (plan-feature convention lookup), and how to verify the fix (reproducer test with whitespace in heading) (Step 4)
assertion_results.evidence: root-cause.md includes all three elements. What: 'extracts CONVENTIONS.md section headings using `line[3:]`, which takes the text after `## ` but does not strip trailing whitespace'. Where: 'The plan-feature skill's convention conformance analysis' and 'plugins/sdlc-workflow/skills/plan-feature/SKILL.md -- convention conformance analysis section, specifically the heading extraction logic'. How to verify: 'Create a test fixture CONVENTIONS.md with trailing whitespace on one or more section headings... Run the plan-feature convention conformance analysis against this fixture and assert that the convention is correctly matched and included in the generated task's Implementation Notes.'

assertion_results.text: Task description has reproducer test as the FIRST acceptance criterion -- before any fix criteria (Step 5 Acceptance Criteria ordering)
assertion_results.evidence: task-description.md Acceptance Criteria section lists reproducer test as the first item: '- [ ] Reproducer test: a test with trailing whitespace on a `CONVENTIONS.md` heading demonstrates the bug (fails before the fix, passes after the fix)'. This precedes the fix criteria: convention heading matching, Implementation Notes inclusion, and no regression.

assertion_results.text: Task description has reproducer test as the FIRST test requirement -- with explicit assertion guidance derived from the Steps to Reproduce (Step 5 Test Requirements ordering)
assertion_results.evidence: task-description.md Test Requirements section lists reproducer test first: '- [ ] Reproducer test: create a `CONVENTIONS.md` fixture with trailing whitespace on the `## Migration Patterns  ` heading; run the convention conformance analysis and assert that the `Migration Patterns` convention is matched and included in the generated task's Implementation Notes (should fail before fix, pass after fix)'. Contains explicit assertion guidance ('assert that the Migration Patterns convention is matched and included in the generated task's Implementation Notes') derived from the Steps to Reproduce (which reference creating CONVENTIONS.md with `## Migration Patterns  ` and inspecting the generated task's Implementation Notes).

assertion_results.text: Task description includes a Bug Context section with Bug key (ACME-500), Steps to Reproduce, Expected/Actual Result, and Root Cause summary (Step 5 Bug Context extension)
